title: 第25章 姜还是老的辣第26章 与敌人斗智
content_zh:
“多谢师兄，师弟感激不尽。”
韩风说完话后，搓着手说道，
“师兄啊，师弟只是一个杂役弟子，这些年攒下来的钱全都拿去买阵法了，身上没有传音玉简啊。”
“你连传音玉简都没有？唉，这些年，真是苦了你了，明明有这么好的资质，却一直做杂役，穷困潦倒的。”
姜怀阳从储物袋里拿出来一个传音玉简，递给了韩风，说道，
“这个玉简给你吧，我身上正好有个多的，你输入灵气将其激活就好，里面有我的神识印记，可以直接跟我通话。”
“多谢师兄，师弟就却之不恭了，来日还你钱。”
韩风接过了传音玉简。
“说什么钱不钱的，都自己人，差这点小钱？行了，我也该回去复命了，刺客这件事，我早晚找到证据，狠狠的惩治叶龙渊和叶家。
走了。”
姜怀阳站起身，和陆玉发一起往外走。
“师兄慢走啊。”
二人拿着刺客尸体，回去执法堂总部了。
韩风把玩着手里的玉简，然后将其收到了储物袋里。
躺床上。
睡觉。
一晚上的风波就这样过去了，今晚对于韩风来说，只是一场小插曲，唯一的收获，可能就是大舅哥看他很顺眼，认为他资质好有稳重，对他非常喜爱。
不过没啥用，韩风连姜酥柔都懒得搭理，更别提这个便宜大舅哥了。
韩风睡的很香，但对于某人来说，今晚注定是一个不眠夜。
叶家祖宅里，叶龙渊坐在床上，拿着玉简，心里挣扎了一个多时辰后，才终于下定决心，找他爹坦白这件事。

毕竟他用的是家里的死士，又不是他一个人的死士，死士是家族里重要的财产，死了四个，他没个交代是说不过去。
坦白从宽，抗拒从严，自首的话，罪过还能轻一点。
叶龙渊离开了房间，走到主卧那边，敲响了房门。
“是渊儿啊，进来吧。”
里面传来了声音。
叶龙渊推开门，里面正堂中间是两个蒲团，盘膝坐着两个人。
一个中年修士，一个看样子只有三十多岁的貌美妇人。
风韵犹存。
“孩儿拜见爹娘。”
叶龙渊抱掌行礼。
他爹睁开眼，问道，
“什么事情，大半夜的过来打扰我修炼？”
叶龙渊跪了下来，说道，
“孩儿向爹请罪。”
“请罪？你这孩子，向来稳当，不惹祸，这是做了什么？要来请罪？”
“事情是这样的，爹，孩儿不是对姜师妹倾心已久，追求多年嘛，前几日相亲大会上，孩儿买通长老，运作了一番……”
当下，叶龙渊把他做的事情，一五一十的全都说了一遍，事无巨细，每一点细节都说了。
听完后，他爹的脸色，阴沉了下来，说道，
“所以说，你不光害死了家里的四名死士，还引起了执法堂的注意，还同时得罪了姜家？”
content_en:
"Thank you, senior brother. I'm very grateful."
After Han Feng finished speaking, he rubbed his hands and said,
"Senior brother, junior brother is just a handyman disciple. All the money he has saved over the years has been used to buy formations. He doesn't have any sound transmission jade slips on him."
"You don't even have a Jade Slip for Sound Transmission? Alas, it's been really hard on you these past years. You obviously have such good qualifications, but you have been working as a handyman and living in poverty."
Jiang Huaiyang took out a sound transmission jade slip from his storage bag, handed it to Han Feng, and said,
"I'll give you this jade slip. I happen to have a lot of it on me. Just input your spiritual energy to activate it. It contains the imprint of my consciousness. You can talk to me directly."
"Thank you, senior brother. I'm sorry for the disrespect. I'll pay you back someday."
Han Feng took the message jade slip.
"What do you mean, we all have money, and we are all short of this little money? Okay, it's time for me to go back and resume my life. Sooner or later, I will find evidence about the assassins and punish Ye Longyuan and the Ye family severely.
Gone. "
Jiang Huaiyang stood up and walked out with Lu Yufa.
"Senior brother, walk slowly."
The two took the assassin's body and returned to the Law Enforcement Hall headquarters.
Han Feng played with the jade slip in his hand and then put it into his storage bag.
Lying on the bed.
sleep.
The storm of the night passed like this. To Han Feng, tonight was just a small episode. The only gain may be that his uncle liked him very much, thought he was very qualified and stable, and liked him very much.
But it was of no use, Han Feng didn't even bother to talk to Jiang Surou, let alone this cheap uncle.
Han Feng slept soundly, but for someone, tonight was destined to be a sleepless night.
In the ancestral house of the Ye family, Ye Longyuan sat on the bed, holding the jade slip. After struggling in his mind for more than an hour, he finally made up his mind to confess the matter to his father.
After all, he used the family's dead soldiers, not his own dead soldiers. The dead soldiers were important assets in the family. Four of them died, and it was unjustifiable for him not to have an explanation.
Those who confess will be given leniency, those who resist will be given stricter punishments, and if they surrender, the crime will be lighter.
Ye Longyuan left the room, walked to the master bedroom, and knocked on the door.
"It's Yuan'er, come in."
There was a voice coming from inside.
Ye Longyuan opened the door, and there were two futons in the middle of the main hall, with two people sitting cross-legged.
A middle-aged monk and a beautiful woman who looked to be in her thirties.
The charm remains.
"Children, meet your parents."
Ye Longyuan held his palms and saluted.
His father opened his eyes and asked,
"What's the matter, coming here in the middle of the night to disturb my practice?"
Ye Longyuan knelt down and said,
"The child apologizes to his father."
"Apologise? You are a kid who has always been safe and stayed out of trouble. What have you done? Are you here to apologize?"
"The thing is like this, dad, hasn't my child been in love with Junior Sister Jiang for a long time and pursued him for many years? At the blind date meeting a few days ago, my child bribed the elders and made a plan..."
At that moment, Ye Longyuan explained everything he had done, down to every detail.
After listening, his father's face darkened and he said,
"So, you not only killed four members of the family, but also attracted the attention of the Law Enforcement Hall, and also offended the Jiang family?"
